Package ch.zhaw.it.pm3.occupi.history.api

package ch.zhaw.it.pm3.occupi.history.api
API definitions for accessing historical room usage data.

This package defines the contract for retrieving and working with historical room occupancy information. It provides an abstraction layer that allows different implementations (file-based, database-based, remote API-based) to be used interchangeably throughout the application.

Core Interface:

  • HistoryAPI - Main interface defining methods for accessing historical usage data

Purpose:

The history API serves several critical functions in the Occupi application:

  • Trend Analysis: Enables identification of usage patterns over time (daily, weekly, seasonal trends)
  • Capacity Planning: Provides data to optimize room allocation based on actual usage statistics
  • Utilization Reports: Supports generation of occupancy reports and analytics for facility management
  • Predictive Insights: Historical data can inform predictions about future room availability and demand

Data Model:

The API works with time-series data represented as: 


 Map<LocalDateTime, Integer>

Where:

  • Key (LocalDateTime): The timestamp of the usage measurement
  • Value (Integer): The number of people occupying the room at that timestamp

Design Principles:

Interface Segregation
The API is focused and minimal, providing only essential methods for historical data access.
Dependency Inversion
Clients depend on this abstraction, not on concrete implementations, enabling flexible data source configurations.
Read-Only Access
The API is designed for read-only operations; history data is typically populated by separate data collection processes.

Implementation Requirements:

Any class implementing HistoryAPI must:

  • Return immutable collections to prevent accidental data modification
  • Handle missing data gracefully (return empty collections, not null)
  • Document error conditions and exceptions clearly
  • Consider thread-safety for multithreaded environments
  • Log errors appropriately without exposing sensitive information

Usage Example:


 public class UsageAnalyzer {
     private final HistoryAPI historyAPI;

     public UsageAnalyzer(HistoryAPI historyAPI) {
         this.historyAPI = historyAPI;
     }

     public double calculateAverageOccupancy(String roomId) {
         Map<LocalDateTime, Integer> history = historyAPI.getRoomUsageHistory(roomId);
         return history.values().stream()
             .mapToInt(Integer::intValue)
             .average()
             .orElse(0.0);
     }
 }

Known Implementations:

  • FileHistoryAPI - File-based implementation using JSON data files

Extension Points:

Future implementations could include:

  • DatabaseHistoryAPI: Reading from a relational database or time-series database
  • RemoteHistoryAPI: Accessing historical data via REST API from a remote service
  • CachedHistoryAPI: Wrapper implementation with caching layer for performance optimization
  • AggregatedHistoryAPI: Combining data from multiple sources
